consequence.statement: Additional certificate output formats are now always enabled and no longer depend on the feature gate.

original.statement: The AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats feature gate is promoted to GA, so additional output formats are always enabled.

decision.reason: [ev-bc29bf53aa1b] says only that the `AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats` feature is promoted to GA and that additional formats are now always enabled. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. So the change is that something is now always on and still works, which fits behavior-change (review), and low severity is reasonable.
